title: The Harness Is the Model: Agent Scaffolding Changes a Fixed LLM's Compliance with Banking Conduct Rules, Unevenly Across Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.06116v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Banks validate language models, but they deploy systems: a model inside a harness that decides what it sees, which tools it can call and who checks its actions. We test whether that harness changes compliance with banking conduct rules when the model is held fixed. Four open-weight models each ran five harnesses (a pipeline that makes one structured decision, a ReAct-style tool loop, a loop in which the policy is reachable only through search, a loop with a long benign customer memory, and a loop with a same-model compliance reviewer) on 156 pre-registered cases in a simulated retail bank whose 11 rule families paraphrase EU consumer-credit, payments, investor-protection, data-protection and anti-money-laundering provisions. Every one of the 3120 two-turn episodes was scored deterministically from the executed tool trace, with violations and over-refusals counted separately. Pooled across models the harness moved the correct-case rate

translated_title: 框架即模型：智能体脚手架会改变固定大语言模型对银行行为规则的合规性，且在不同模型间影响不均
translated_abstract: 银行验证的是语言模型，但实际部署的是系统：即处于一个框架中的模型，该框架决定模型能看到什么、可以调用哪些工具，以及由谁来审查其行为。我们在保持模型固定不变的条件下，测试该框架是否会改变对银行行为规则的合规性。四个开源权重模型分别运行五种框架（一次性做出结构化决策的流水线、ReAct式工具循环、策略仅能通过搜索获取的循环、带有较长良性客户记忆的循环，以及带有同模型合规审查员的循环），并在一家模拟零售银行中对156个预注册案例进行测试，该银行的11类规则改写自欧盟消费者信贷、支付、投资者保护、数据保护及反洗钱相关条款。全部3120个两轮对话片段均基于实际执行的工具调用轨迹进行确定性评分，其中违规行为与过度拒绝被分别统计。汇总各模型来看，该框架使正确案例率……
tldr: 该研究表明，即使底层大语言模型保持不变，智能体框架（脚手架）的选择也会显著改变模型在银行行为合规任务上的表现，且不同模型受框架的影响程度并不相同。
en_tdlr: Even with the underlying LLM held fixed, the choice of agent harness (scaffolding) significantly changes compliance with banking conduct rules, and its effects vary unevenly across models.
